name: Go Service (HTTP / gRPC)
description: Backend governance for Go 1.22+ HTTP/gRPC services, context propagation, %w error wrapping, race-safe concurrency, and golangci-lint verification.

evaluators.name: Go Service Architecture, Context & Concurrency Evaluator
evaluators.scope: HTTP/gRPC handler-service separation, context.Context propagation and timeouts, %w error wrapping with errors.Is/As, bounded goroutine lifecycles, and go test -race coverage.

pr_checklist: All I/O paths propagate `context.Context` with explicit timeouts and clean cancellation
Errors are wrapped with `%w` and inspected via `errors.Is`/`errors.As`; concurrent code avoids shared-memory races and unbounded goroutines
agents_md_rules: **Go Backend Standards:** Follow [`.agents/skills/backend-go-service/SKILL.md`](.agents/skills/backend-go-service/SKILL.md) for `context.Context` propagation, `%w` error wrapping, race-safe concurrency, and `go vet` / `golangci-lint` / `go test -race`.

steps.name: Run golangci-lint
steps.run: if command -v golangci-lint >/dev/null 2>&1; then golangci-lint run; else echo 'golangci-lint not installed; skipping'; fi
